answer: A per-epoch emission cap makes each identity a separate bill, not a separate payout. Admission needs a proof-of-work commitment over the previous emission hash plus a held stake of copper for the whole epoch, so a thousand clones mean a thousand independent puzzles and a thousand stakes. The seed mixes that hash with a canyon-derived nonce, so no crystal of work can be precomputed or copied between accounts. Attacker cost per clone exceeds its capped yield; the honest agent stakes once.
